title: Progression Re-Envisioned
description: Changes the progression enough to be understandable but interesting. Also adds fun trinkets to mess with and QOL Improvements.
body:
# Welcome to Progression Re-Envisioned!

This mod aims to change minecrafts progression in an interesting yet understandable way. it also add fun and useful tools for any situation.

(No AI has been used thoughout the making of this project. if it looks like AI, its just me sucking at pixel art lol XD)

### **Commonly Asked Questions**

**Will this be ported to XX.XX version?**
There are plans to port to the newest version but we will see what happens. as for backports, the only ones im seeing are one time backports to 1.19.2, 1.20.1, and 1.21.1.

**Will this mod be on XXX mod loader?**
Its already on fabric and quilt works with most fabric mods, neoforge may happen but im not sure when, and forge might happen but is unlikely.

**Will this mod be compatable with XXX?**
I cannot guarentee that every mod will have compat with Progression Re-Envisioned (PRE for short) but I will try to make it as compatable as possible but we will see.
